cover_headline: Alberta Invites 425 Workers in Five Provincial Immigration Draws
facts: Alberta issued 425 invitations to apply for provincial nomination across five AAIP draws held between October 23 and November 2, with minimum scores between 50 and 60
The Rural Renewal Stream accounted for 210 of the invitations; the Alberta Opportunity Stream issued 132 and the two Dedicated Health Care Pathway draws issued 83 combined
Alberta had issued 6,108 of its 6,603 nominations for 2026 as of November 4, leaving 495 spaces, with 32,211 candidates still active in the expression-of-interest pool

end.headline: Alberta Invites 425 Workers in Five Provincial Immigration Draws
end.line: The Alberta Advantage Immigration Program issued 425 invitations across five draws between October 23 and November 2, led by the Rural Renewal Stream — but only 495 of the province's 6,603 nomination spaces for 2026 remain.
